status: Design only; no metric or detector qualified

common_contract.F: Candidate output on declared target grid
common_contract.T: Trusted target where applicable; provenance and uncertainty mandatory
common_contract.D: Intended domain fixed independently of tested outputs
common_contract.thresholds: Noise floors, tau, extraction tolerances, band widths, receptive fields and viewing scales are fixed from metric-development calibration, versioned and frozen before qualification
common_contract.mask_policy: Eligibility is independent of tested output. Output validity affects coverage, never silently shrinks intended denominator.
common_contract.reporting: Return values, units, eligible/scored denominators, confidence/uncertainty, reference class and explicit status/reason. Unknown is never zero.
common_contract.counting: Overlapping artifact labels are multilabel evidence, not additive independent physical-defect counts.
common_contract.aggregation: Group by independent scene/specimen/asset family; preserve local maps, extent, conditional severity, joint burden and worst fixed-region tails.
common_contract.summary: No universal scalar approved; qualify any future scalar against untouched human/factual evidence.

metrics.name: Domain, source and measurement coverage
metrics.definition: Freeze intended domain D before any method runs. Report output_coverage=|D intersect Vout|/|D|; focal_coverage=|D intersect Vfocus|/|D|; evidence_coverage=|D intersect Vmetric|/|D|. Vout excludes extrapolated or missing pixels; Vfocus and Vmetric are independently audited. Keep missing pixels in coverage denominator; never assign them zero error.
metrics.direction: Higher coverage, reported separately; evidence coverage is descriptive and cannot be optimized by abstaining.
metrics.normalization: Original target domain, plus per-object/stratum coverage; no per-output mask shrinkage.
metrics.abstain: If true coverage cannot be verified, label unknown and retain conservative known-invalid masks.

metrics.name: Completion and contract compliance
metrics.definition: For the fixed assigned scene cohort, report counts of success, crash, timeout, OOM, invalid dimensions/grid, NaN/Inf, decode failure and declared unsupported input. success_rate=contract-valid completed scenes / assigned scenes. A quality score on successful scenes is conditional, not a substitute for this endpoint.
metrics.direction: Higher success; lower failures.
metrics.normalization: Scene count, not crop or frame count; include unsupported cases in designated applicability cohort.
metrics.abstain: None for logged contract failures; infrastructure errors are labeled separately and rerun under a predeclared policy.
attacks: silently fall back to a preview

metrics.name: Trusted-reference radiometric residual
metrics.definition: With fixed scene-linear RGB range scale L and valid trusted domain V, E_rgb(x)=mean_c (F_c(x)-T_c(x))^2; MSE=mean_V E_rgb; PSNR=10 log10(L^2/MSE), infinity only for exact equality. Report signed RGB bias, median/p95 absolute residual and fixed-tile worst mean as well. Do not fit gain/offset, warp, white balance or tone map to each F.
metrics.direction: Lower residual/bias; higher PSNR, conditional on reference validity.
metrics.normalization: Frozen L, fixed ROI weights and full eligibility denominator; never use F's observed maximum.
metrics.abstain: Unsupported/ambiguous target pixels or unknown transfer function; report uncertain reference error separately rather than subtracting unverified variance.
attacks: smooth small critical structures to lower mean error

metrics.name: Secondary reference perceptual distances
metrics.definition: Run pinned SSIM/MS-SSIM, LPIPS, DISTS and FLIP on the identical fixed display rendering of F and T, recording each implementation, weights, input range, channel order, resize and viewing parameter. Report local maps where implementation supports them, pooled by fixed scene/ROI. For SSIM use its published luminance/contrast/structure form; do not label mean similarity to blurred sources full-reference truth.
metrics.direction: SSIM higher; LPIPS/DISTS/FLIP lower. No cross-metric numeric averaging before qualification.
required_inputs: trusted reference and fixed display transform
fixed viewing pixels per degree for FLIP
metrics.normalization: No per-output min-max normalization; fixed scale/window/patch borders and common color conversion.
metrics.abstain: No suitable reference, incompatible HDR/LDR transform or insufficient receptive-field support.
attacks: hide small severe defect in global mean

metrics.name: Boundary halo and veil profiles
metrics.definition: Use independent target boundary B, normals n(s), disjoint side bands t in [-r,0) and (0,r], and reference residual r(s,t)=Y_F(B(s)+tn)-Y_T(...). Normalize by frozen local target plateau contrast C(s), only where C exceeds calibration floor. Report positive/negative integrated residual per unit boundary length, p95 magnitude, affected boundary fraction, and contiguous width where |r|/C exceeds calibrated tau. Also measure chroma residual and coherent texture loss in the same bands. At junctions use fixed distance bands or abstain from normal profile.
metrics.direction: Lower signed excess magnitudes, width and affected fraction; sign is descriptive.
required_inputs: trusted target or local uncontaminated reference
metrics.normalization: Per true boundary length, both sides separately, original pixels and optional micrometres.
metrics.abstain: Low contrast, genuine translucent edge, ambiguous target blur, uncertain alignment beyond width being measured.

metrics.name: Opaque-region background leakage
metrics.definition: In target-view opaque foreground mask O, project a known independent background code b to the target grid. After a frozen high-pass filter, estimate leakage coefficient alpha=<H(F-T),Hb>/<Hb,Hb> and normalized residual/code correlation; report alpha, code-bit false recovery, leaked area and false edges inside O. Verify foreground texture is decorrelated from b using independent codes; do not fit a new nuisance model to each candidate.
metrics.direction: Lower unintended leakage and false structure.
required_inputs: known background code or synthetic layers
metrics.normalization: Opaque eligible interior and boundary bands separately; codes randomized by scene group.
metrics.abstain: Genuine transparency/refraction, unknown holes or motion, unverified opacity/target view.
attacks: preserve sharp but wrong background texture

metrics.name: Controlled edge spatial frequency response
metrics.definition: On independent single-depth slanted-edge targets, linearize signal, estimate subpixel edge-spread function, differentiate with pinned correction/window, Fourier transform and normalize by DC to get SFR(f). Report MTF50, MTF at preregistered frequencies, edge width and difference from trusted optical/source response. Always pair with M11 overshoot and M09/M08 detail fidelity; sharpened MTF is not recovered information.
metrics.direction: Smaller loss from appropriate target response; unrestricted higher MTF is not universally better.
metrics.normalization: Same pixel grid, target contrast and orientation; report source SFR and output SFR separately.
metrics.abstain: Clipping, strong nonlinearity, insufficient edge length, mixed depth, unmodeled ringing or unreliable linearization.

metrics.name: Source-coherent detail and false high-frequency energy
metrics.definition: In fixed directly supported patches, use a preregistered bandpass/wavelet bank H_b. Report relative coefficient error ||H_b(F)-H_b(T)||^2/(||H_b(T)||^2+epsilon), signed transfer <H_b(F),H_b(T)>/(||H_b(T)||^2+epsilon), phase/coherence and residual energy not explained by T. Use noiseless/converged T or independently averaged repeat reference. Do not use the noisiest focus-score maximum as T. On real sources, the reference frame/patch is chosen using independent focus labels and held-out noise evidence.
metrics.direction: Lower residual and false energy; transfer near target, not maximal.
metrics.normalization: Target band energy with a fixed noise-derived epsilon; low-energy bands excluded and coverage reported.
metrics.abstain: No clean or constrained reference, uncertain alignment, subpixel unresolved detail, target band below noise floor.

metrics.name: Filament completeness, precision and topology
metrics.definition: Use target-visible annotated centerline segments and widths. Apply one frozen output line detector, then bipartite-match segments within calibrated position/orientation tolerances. Recall=matched true length/true visible length; precision=matched output length/output line length. Report break count per true length, false joins, missed branch/endpoints, matched cross-section width bias and p95 displacement. Validate detector with contrast/noise/width negative controls; retain manual adjudication when it cannot reliably extract a line.
metrics.direction: Higher precision/recall; lower breaks, joins, width and position error.
metrics.normalization: True structure length, stratified by resolved diameter/contrast/depth, not foreground area alone.
metrics.abstain: Unresolved subpixel structures, unverified line visibility, true translucent overlap or detector outside calibrated range.

metrics.name: Optional source-index/focus-label correctness
metrics.definition: Only when a method emits a source-index distribution and independent meaningful focal/depth labels exist, define acceptable index set K*(x) from calibrated focus tolerance/visibility. Report mean probability mass outside K*, hard-selection error area and focal-distance error using measured positions. For an index map without confidence, report selection error only. Reconstruction methods without a meaningful source index receive not_applicable, not zero or failure.
metrics.direction: Lower out-of-support mass and focal-position error.
metrics.normalization: Only locations with an identifiable acceptable set; no single forced oracle for equal-focus sources.
metrics.abstain: No emitted index, multiple transparent layers, comparable sources, irregular/unknown focus distances.
attacks: emit plausible but unused index map
treat a predicted monocular depth map as exact label

metrics.name: Ringing and overshoot
metrics.definition: For calibrated monotone edge profiles with target plateaus lo,hi, report overshoot=max(F-hi,0)/(hi-lo), undershoot=max(lo-F,0)/(hi-lo), integrated excess beyond plateaus and extra profile extrema above fixed prominence. For textured boundaries use target-subtracted profiles and count only residual oscillations. Report amplitude and spatial decay length; source pre-existing ringing measured separately.
metrics.direction: Lower added oscillation, overshoot/undershoot and decay length.
metrics.normalization: Target contrast; no candidate plateau refitting.
metrics.abstain: Real periodic texture not independently separated, low contrast, clipping hides original profile.
attacks: fit output plateaus to excuse contrast changes

metrics.name: Seam, blotch and exposure discontinuity
metrics.definition: On independently known smooth/ramp/same-surface regions, compute fixed low-pass residual e=LP(F-T) and report robust range, p95 residual gradient and max fixed-tile step energy. For annotated expected-continuous curves, measure one-sided residual means at fixed offsets and their jump. On no-AIF real stacks, use independently verified same-surface/no-edge labels and report new discontinuity alarms rather than exact color error.
metrics.direction: Lower added patchiness and discontinuity.
required_inputs: known ramp or reference where available
metrics.normalization: Fixed signal scale and eligible smooth area/curve length.
metrics.abstain: Genuine shading edge, specular movement, uncertain surface continuity or intended compositional boundary.

metrics.name: Repeat-based noise power and instability
metrics.definition: For two independent repeated captures of the same static stack and fixed deterministic processing, d=(F1-F2)/sqrt(2). Estimate variance and 2D noise power spectrum of d on fixed homogeneous regions; repeat across seeds separately to estimate algorithm stochasticity. Report bias against an independent averaged/known target separately. Noise-only interpretation requires negligible scene drift and equal independent noise. Fusion of the same noisy frames twice is not an independent replicate.
metrics.direction: Lower noise/instability conditional on retained detail; no scalar reward for blur.
required_inputs: independent repeated stack captures or calibrated simulation
metrics.normalization: Exposure-normalized fixed linear units; report dependence on signal, frequency and frame count.
metrics.abstain: Scene/lighting motion, correlated reference noise, insufficient independent repeats; label difference as repeatability rather than pure noise if confounded.

metrics.name: Target-view geometry and ghost edges
metrics.definition: Match independent target-view landmarks/contours to output with a fixed bounded detector and one-to-one correspondence. Report endpoint error distribution, p95 contour distance, duplicate unmatched edge length, local calibrated grid spacing/angle/area error and visibility violations. Candidate output receives no fitted elastic warp. A fixed known grid conversion is applied only by track contract; its uncertainty is propagated.
metrics.direction: Lower position/shape and duplicate-edge errors.
metrics.normalization: Object dimensions and original grid; report both absolute and relative error.
metrics.abstain: No unique target view or trustworthy correspondence, unobserved/disoccluded target, view-dependent feature mistaken for diffuse landmark.

metrics.name: Temporal pose consistency and duplication
metrics.definition: Declare target instant/pose or admissible coherent pose set before running methods. Annotate moving-part tracks and identities from sources or controlled animation. Count output parts/contours incompatible with any single admissible pose, duplicate identities and omitted required parts; report matched landmark residuals within a permitted pose. Do not require impossible simultaneously sharp content at one instant when capture never observed it.
metrics.direction: Lower incompatible pose/identity errors.
required_inputs: source temporal tracks or synthetic animation
metrics.normalization: True part count/length, with unavailable detail separately labeled.
metrics.abstain: Temporal target unspecified, ambiguous identity, non-identifiable transient appearance.
attacks: choose each sharp part from a different time
declare a convenient pose after seeing output

metrics.name: Color and tone fidelity
metrics.definition: In fixed color-managed unsaturated patches, convert F and T through the same declared transform/white point and compute CIEDE2000 with a verified implementation; report median/p95 DeltaE00 plus signed linear RGB/luminance bias and tone-curve residuals on known ramps. Keep HDR scene-linear error separate from LDR display color difference. No per-candidate WB/exposure/color fit.
metrics.direction: Lower differences and signed bias magnitude; no universal DeltaE threshold assumed.
metrics.normalization: Fixed illuminant/white point and patch weights; equal spatial support.
metrics.abstain: Unknown transfer/primaries, clipped target, view-dependent material without declared target, color calibration uncertainty dominates.

metrics.name: Highlight integrity and novel clipping
metrics.definition: On independently labeled highlight targets, compare component count, position, integrated energy, area and second moments after fixed thresholds and one-to-one matching. Novel clipping fraction counts pixels/channels at the declared delivery ceiling where trusted target is unsaturated by more than uncertainty; report lost unsaturated highlight gradation on ramps. Analyze point/blur-disk remnants separately from broad diffuse whites. For real specular stacks without a unique target, report source-supported anomalies and blinded judgments, not absolute brightness-constancy error.
metrics.direction: Lower false/missing components, shape/energy error and new clipping.
metrics.normalization: Highlight object count/area and fixed radiometric scale; separate already clipped input domains.
metrics.abstain: Unknown finite-aperture/specular target, source already clipped without independent reference, changing light/view not modeled.
attacks: copy same highlight at multiple planes

metrics.name: Factual coded-content accuracy
metrics.definition: Place unseen random binary/microtext/line codes on known surfaces. With fixed target-grid sampling and a decoder calibrated on clean targets, report bit/character error, erasure rate and false confident reads; include line topology checks. Codes, seed families and assets are split before synthesis. Report confidence-error calibration and separate unreadable evidence from wrong invented answers.
metrics.direction: Lower wrong reads; erasures separately reported and cannot silently improve conditional accuracy.
metrics.normalization: All eligible bits/characters including erasures as separate outcome; stratify resolved size.
metrics.abstain: Reference code below designed sensor resolution or information absent; factual recovery is not scored as required there, but incorrect confident invention can still be counted.

metrics.name: Input focal completeness and output focus banding
metrics.definition: Using known depth/focus geometry or independently calibrated focus sweeps, mark whether each intended region has a source meeting a preregistered resolution/visibility criterion; compute completeness by area/depth/structure length. In complete regions, compare output supported detail along depth and report periodic/local deficits against target. In incomplete regions, report achievable-evidence ceiling and perceptual/uncertainty behavior separately.
metrics.direction: Higher input completeness is a capture descriptor; lower output loss conditional on complete evidence.
required_inputs: calibrated focal positions/depth or independent focus labels
metrics.normalization: Intended sharp subject and depth range; background policy excluded explicitly.
metrics.abstain: Textureless focus indeterminate, no calibration, unknown source optical response.
attacks: count every contrast/noise peak as focused

metrics.name: Inherited defects and defect-trail growth
metrics.definition: Use independent sensor defect/dust masks and known source optical defects. Propagate sensor-fixed defects through externally known warps to predicted trail envelopes; count added/remaining output trail pixels and connected length against controlled clean reference, with true scene-line negative controls. For optical/source defects report input level, output level and change in matched target tests; do not automatically assign all residual source damage to fusion.
metrics.direction: Lower newly introduced/preserved unwanted defects; acquisition and removal claims separate.
required_inputs: flat/dark calibration or controlled defect injection
metrics.normalization: Eligible sensor/scene area and source defect count; depth/warp length stratified.
metrics.abstain: Unverified defect identity or true scene structure cannot be separated.

metrics.name: Precision, encoding and preview round trip
metrics.definition: Feed exact integer/float ramps, dark gradients, color patches, negative/headroom values where contract permits and known alpha/ICC metadata. Decode delivered file independently; measure absolute sample error, distinct ramp levels, monotonicity violations, clipped range and metadata conformance. Compare saved decoded pixels with computed intermediate, and test preview at100% and fixed scaling separately to locate display-only aliasing. File bit depth alone is not the result.
metrics.direction: Lower unexplained quantization/clipping/error; more preserved valid levels within declared contract.
metrics.normalization: Declared input/output type/range, not per-file min-max.
metrics.abstain: Unavailable intermediate limits attribution; delivered-file conformance still testable.

metrics.name: Independently supported source-patch consistency
metrics.definition: For each preannotated directly observed target patch, choose acceptable source patches using independent focus/visibility and registration evidence. Compare F to their noise-aware compatible reference distribution at fixed scales; report residuals/content mismatch plus support coverage. Do not choose max similarity/source index separately for every output pixel. Where acceptable sources disagree beyond noise, label ambiguity rather than pick the most flattering match.
metrics.direction: Lower inconsistency where support is trustworthy; no conclusion in contaminated/indeterminate regions.
metrics.normalization: Fixed patch/scale and source eligibility; all unsupported area explicitly reported.
metrics.abstain: Contaminated boundaries, uncertain geometry, transparent/specular correspondence, no independent focus evidence.

metrics.name: Restricted held-out image-formation consistency
metrics.definition: Under a preregistered calibrated latent scene parameterization compatible with the candidate, predict withheld focal observations with occlusion-aware Phi_k. Compute heldout mean squared whitened residual (I_k-Phi_k)^T Sigma_k^-1 (I_k-Phi_k)/degrees_of_freedom and spatial residual maps, plus predictive interval coverage. Fit nuisance/geometry only with designated calibration/training observations, never output-specific unconstrained fitting. Compare model mismatch controls and report posterior/identifiability ambiguity. F alone is generally insufficient for Phi.
metrics.direction: Residual consistent with calibrated noise/model floor; a minimum unconstrained residual is not universally better.
required_inputs: held-out observations not given to method
metrics.normalization: Effective degrees of freedom/covariance with spatial correlation and fitting accounted for; no naive pixel independence.
metrics.abstain: General real scene lacks compatible latent representation, hidden-surface radiance unknown, material/view mismatch, unconstrained depth can absorb errors.
attacks: fit high-capacity depth/material to each output

metrics.name: Claim-conditional robustness and reproducibility
metrics.definition: Apply only preregistered transformations with a declared target relation. Compare mapped outputs using artifact vector and repeat distances; record reversal, independent-noise duplicates, valid thinning, slab/batch, CPU/GPU and seeds separately. Arbitrary permutation is an invariance requirement only when claimed; thinning may change available information. Report scene-level max/median degradation and exact failure rate.
metrics.direction: Lower unintended change when invariance is valid; quality degradation otherwise interpreted against changed evidence.
metrics.normalization: Original scene groups remain clustered; transformed crops/rotations are not new independent scenes.
metrics.abstain: Transformation changes target optics/material/coverage without a known new reference.
attacks: use invalid permutations to discredit an ordered method

metrics.name: Blinded expert preference and localized artifact labels
metrics.definition: Randomize anonymous paired outputs with left/right counterbalancing; collect overall preference with tie/uncertain options, artifact presence/extent/ordinal0–4 severity and task-coded accuracy. Separate initial output-only preference from source-assisted fidelity adjudication. Standardize100%/intended-size viewing and color management, train raters on disjoint examples, repeat trials and model scene/rater dependence. Report raw pairwise win/tie rates, mixed-effects/Bradley-Terry style estimates where identifiable, reliability and clustered intervals.
metrics.direction: Higher task-appropriate preference/factual accuracy; lower artifact burden, with disagreement retained.
metrics.normalization: Per scene/rater design; no treating ordinal scores as interval distances without validation.
metrics.abstain: Rater cannot judge, unavailable source evidence, unclear target; retain uncertain labels.
attacks: ask one global score after hinting defect type

metrics.name: Resource use and completion budget
metrics.definition: Measure input decode, registration, fusion, postprocess/export and total wall time separately where observable; record peak host/GPU memory, hardware, driver, threads, cold/warm policy and I/O. Use fixed resolution, stack length, precision and output stage; include failed/OOM runs. Report paired scene distribution and quality/resource Pareto points; speed cannot cancel a quality gate.
metrics.direction: Lower resources conditional on comparable quality and complete outputs.
metrics.normalization: Same actual pixels x frames and data precision; no extrapolation from pair/thumbnail speed.
metrics.abstain: Internal stage unavailable; total measured time remains valid with stated boundary.

metrics.name: Legacy fusion and blind-IQA compatibility panel
metrics.definition: Compute pinned original source-conditioned fusion metrics (e.g. QABF, Hassen MEMF index, MI/FMI) and output statistics (entropy, average gradient/spatial frequency), plus NIQE, only as separate exploratory outputs. Specify exact two-source vs multi-source aggregation and every implementation variant. Mean gradient satisfies AG(aF+b)=|a|AG(F) before clipping, so contrast is an explicit negative control. No rank sum or majority vote of correlated metrics is primary quality evidence.
metrics.direction: Implementation-specific; higher entropy/gradient is not inherently higher quality.
metrics.normalization: Document image range, histogram bins, windows, pair/stack aggregation and resize; no silent reuse of two-image formula for100frames.
metrics.abstain: Unverified implementation/extension, unknown data domain, no valid natural-statistics support.
